features.name: x001_centered_z_clip
features.description: Clipped z-style normalization of x001 using the training-fold mean and scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-aligned continuous input so a linear SVM can assign a stable margin weight without raw-unit dominance.

features.name: overall_centered_level
features.description: Average standardized level across all five numeric columns, clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures broad elevation or depression as a smooth near-linear projection for margin placement.

features.name: first_three_vs_last_two_z_contrast
features.description: Contrasts the average standardized level of x001-x003 against x004-x005.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a signed axis separating early-column and later-column behavior in one bounded feature.

features.name: x001_x002_signed_balance
features.description: Bounded signed ratio comparing x001 with x002, damped by their absolute magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a stable pairwise imbalance cue while limiting leverage from extreme raw values.

features.name: x003_x004_signed_balance
features.description: Bounded signed ratio comparing x003 with x004, damped by their absolute magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a stable pairwise imbalance cue while limiting leverage from extreme raw values.

features.name: radial_standardized_deviation
features.description: Euclidean norm of the five standardized deviations from the training-fold center, clipped for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes overall distance from the central profile as one smooth severity measure.

features.name: coherent_direction_score
features.description: Assessor score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how consistently the five measurements sit on the same side of their training-fold means; high values indicate a coherent one-direction profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a bounded shape cue that can improve a linear margin when individual coordinates have coordinated movement.

features.name: unusual_profile_shape_score
features.description: Assessor score from 0.0 to 1.0 for unusual multi-column profile geometry relative to the training-fold ranges, considering simultaneous extremes and uneven spacing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth expert-style severity measure that complements radial distance and pair ratios.
